A connected AI team

More than posts. More than ads.

Zen brings your conversations, customer relationships, campaigns and business answers into one workspace. Start with the work that matters most to you.

Handles customer conversations

Prices, availability, directions, parking, what to bring — answered in your own tone, using what your business actually charges and when it is actually open.

Creates content for every channel

A product photo or a one-line idea becomes a finished, on-brand post, story or short video — captioned, sized and ready to publish.

Remembers and re-engages customers

Birthday, win-back and gentle-nudge messages that send themselves — and are measured against a real held-back group, so you know whether they worked.

Plans and watches campaigns

From audience and budget to Meta ads and WhatsApp follow-up, Zen connects the campaign to enquiries and bookings, then flags wasted spend.

Answers business questions

Ask what changed, who came back or which campaign brought visits. Zen explains the answer in plain language from connected data.

Keeps you in charge

Set what Zen may send on its own and what waits for you. Change your mind whenever you like — the rules are yours, not ours.

Campaigns, running quietly in the background

The relationships that keep the business moving.

Zen helps you notice customers who have gone quiet, follow up on unanswered enquiries and remember meaningful moments. Your approval rules determine when a message may go out.

  1. ◷ Lapsed customers

    "We have not seen Amira in eleven weeks." A win-back offer goes out before she finds another salon.

  2. ↻ Nudge the nearly-booked

    Asked about prices on Tuesday, never came back. A single follow-up two days later, not a pile of them.

  3. ✦ Birthdays

    The week before, not the day after. A free birthday chair, sent to the right child's parent automatically.

  4. ◔ Fill a quiet day

    Tuesday is looking empty. Zen offers the open slots to nearby regulars rather than discounting to everyone.

  5. ◎ Replies that sound like you

    When someone answers, Zen carries on the conversation, checks the calendar, holds the slot — and hands anything unusual to you.

  6. ◫ Measured against a held-back group

    Zen deliberately does not message a slice of the list, then compares. The lift you see is real, not a flattering total.

Nothing sends until you say so — or until you decide it can. Review every message, approve a batch at a time, or switch a campaign to automatic once you trust it. You can switch it back on any Tuesday you like.
"Hi Reem — Layla is due for a trim. Saturday 3pm is free." "Happy birthday, Aanya! Your birthday chair is on us this week." Example: +14 pts lift against a held-back group Example: AED 2,559 from WhatsApp campaigns, net of sending cost

Control and safety

You choose what Zen can do on its own.

Trusting software with your customers is a big ask. Zen is built so you never have to trust it further than you have chosen to.

Your rules decide everything

Pick what Zen may send on its own, what waits for approval, and what it should never touch. Start with everything held for review and loosen it as you get comfortable.

Your data stays yours

Each business sits in its own isolated workspace with its own login. Your customer list is never pooled, shared or used to train anything for anyone else.

Honest measurement, not flattery

Campaigns are tested against a held-back group of customers who get nothing. If a campaign did not actually work, Zen says so rather than taking credit for people who were coming anyway.

24/7 Customers get a real answer at 11pm, on a Friday, mid-haircut.
5 apps → 1 Messaging, design, scheduling, ads and reporting in one place.
~1 afternoon From signing up to your first automatic reply going out.
0 surprises Nothing reaches a customer unless your rules allow it.

Figures describe how Zen is set up to work, not averaged customer results.

Before you start

The questions owners actually ask.

Is Zen only for Instagram and Facebook?

No. Zen also handles WhatsApp conversations, customer follow-up, win-back campaigns and business questions. Social content and ads are part of a wider connected workflow.

Will Zen message my customers without me knowing?

No. You choose what is allowed to go out on its own and what waits for your review. Until you say otherwise, everything is held for you to approve, and you can see every message Zen has sent.

Do I need design or marketing experience?

No. Zen asks about your business in plain language and does the writing, design and setup itself. Your job is to look at what it made and say yes or no.

I already use WhatsApp Business. Does that break?

No. Zen connects to your existing WhatsApp Business account. Your number, your chat history and your customers stay exactly where they are.

What happens when Zen does not know the answer?

It stops and hands the conversation to you rather than guessing. Those chats appear at the top of your home screen so nothing sits unanswered.

Will it sound like a robot to my customers?

Zen learns your tone during setup and uses your real prices, hours and service names. You can read and edit any reply it drafts, and adjust how it sounds whenever you like.

Can I cancel any time?

Yes, any time, with no lock-in. Your data stays yours and can be exported before you go.
